answer: We establish Sybil resistance by bounding the transition probability of a random walk voyage across any sparse cut, or bridge, connecting the honest network to an adversarial cluster. By integrating a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function with heavy slashing penalties on staking collateral, we force a negative expected attack utility that leaves malicious actors isolated in an economic tundra of forfeited capital. Consequently, the EigenTrust transition matrix converges asymptotically to a robust Nash equilibrium among honest validator nodes.
